worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.summary: Dig in and leap over the ground to smash down on the target: the landing is heavy and may leave it confused. Every enemy in the landing ring is struck, and the ground is clawed into a patch of overturned earth. Accuracy is only 85, so missing is common.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.use.1: Leap a short distance into a group
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.use.2: Catch two or three with the landing ring
The landing deals %1$s physical damage; the leap reaches %2$s blocks and the landing ring is %3$s blocks (the drawn dust ring is the hit area).
On a solid hit, %1$s chance to leave the target confused for %2$s; each action it starts then has %3$s chance to be broken.
Accuracy 85 really does veer (%1$s degrees per missing point); leap height %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.vault.on: Vault: leaps farther and higher with a wider landing ring and a bigger scuff, at the cost of longer windup/cooldown and a wider aim spread (easier to miss).
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.vault.off: Ground Pounce: a low, fast pounce with a tighter aim spread and more consistency, at the cost of a shorter leap and a smaller landing ring.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.growth.0: From level %1$s the pounce power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.growth.1: From level %1$s the pounce power rises to %2$s and the confuse chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.preference.v: On: leaps farther and higher with x1.35 landing radius and a bigger scuff, but longer windup/recover/cooldown and a wider aim spread (easier to miss). Off (Ground Pounce): a low, fast pounce with a tighter spread and more consistency, at the cost of range and radius.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first; the leap is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
On: lower-health targets rank higher for the finishing pounce; off: all targets rank alike.
On: a target with other enemies around it ranks higher, since the landing ring can catch several; off: normal melee ordering.
